They’re breaking every rule

But walking away is impossible

Injured ballerina Willow Carter came home to heal. She didn’t come home for trouble.

But trouble has a name in Autumn Falls – Dylan Hawkins.

Their families have been enemies for as long as either of them can remember. Only now, Dylan is nothing like the reckless football star Willow secretly watched from the bleachers in high school. And when a wayward horse brings them together, old sparks refuse to go out.

Loving a Hawkins could cost Willow everything. Will she keep dancing to everyone else’s expectations, or risk it all?
